categories.main_business_segments: Hunan Changyuan Lico Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, production, and sales of high-efficiency lithium-ion battery cathode materials, including ternary cathode materials (with self-supplied precursors), lithium cobalt oxide cathode materials, and spherical nickel. The company is expanding into lithium iron phosphate cathode materials and focuses on providing high safety, high energy density, and long cycle life cathode materials for new energy batteries.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company possesses advanced technologies in precursor synthesis, cathode material preparation, and recycling of spent batteries. It has developed high-voltage ternary, ultra-high nickel, high-power ternary, lithium iron phosphate, and sodium battery materials, with several products reaching industrialization and mass production. The company employs integrated precursor and cathode material production, ensuring control over core supply chain elements and product quality.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading lithium battery manufacturers such as CATL, BYD, EVE Energy, Sunwoda, and Honeycomb Energy. The company serves the new energy vehicle market, 3C electronics, and energy storage sectors. It has established cooperation with seven of the top ten domestic power battery companies and international clients like Panasonic, Murata, Saft, and Toyota's PPES.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China, with headquarters and production facilities in Changsha, Hunan Province. It is actively expanding its international market presence, collaborating with customers in Japan, Germany, and other countries, and aims to integrate into the global new energy materials supply network.
categories.supply_chain_position: Changyuan Lico operates in the midstream segment of the lithium-ion battery supply chain, focusing on cathode material production. It integrates upstream precursor production through its wholly-owned subsidiary Jinchi Materials, securing core raw materials and enhancing supply chain control.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes technological innovation in high-nickel ternary materials, lithium iron phosphate, sodium battery materials, and spent battery recycling. It maintains a sustainable R&D system with significant investment, focusing on product performance, cost reduction, and new material development. Future R&D includes solid-state batteries, lithium-rich manganese-based materials, and expanding recycling technologies.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of cathode materials to battery manufacturers. The company employs a direct sales model with differentiated credit policies based on customer credit ratings. It also benefits from government subsidies and investment income related to its core business.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Changyuan Lico is among the leading domestic producers of ternary cathode materials, holding a top position in shipment volumes in China. It competes with major players like CATL, BYD, and other established lithium battery material suppliers. The company leverages its early market entry, technological advantages, and integration with China Minmetals to strengthen its competitive position.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2022, the company achieved revenue of approximately RMB 17.98 billion, a 162.75% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 1.49 billion, up 112.59%. Total assets nearly doubled to RMB 17.66 billion. The company has shown rapid growth driven by strong market demand and capacity expansion projects.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Changyuan Lico offers high-performance cathode materials with superior safety, energy density, and cycle life, supported by advanced technology and integrated precursor production. Its products meet stringent quality standards and are recognized by leading battery manufacturers. The company’s integration with China Minmetals provides resource security and financial backing, enhancing its reliability and market influence.
